title: Windowed Integrator
text: 阻断直流分量，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Algorithm for estimating DC offset} 指定估计直流偏置的算法；{Normalized bandwidth of lowpass IIR or CIC filter} 指定归一化带宽、{Order of lowpass IIR elliptic filter} 指定低通 IIR 椭圆滤波器的阶数、{Number of past input samples for FIR algorithm} 指定 FIR 算法使用的过去输入采样数、{View Filter Response} 指定可视化频率响应、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: 不含直流分量的输出信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Algorithm for estimating DC offset
params.values: 估计直流偏置的算法 IIR (default) | FIR | CIC | Subtract mean

params.name: Normalized bandwidth of lowpass IIR or CIC filter
params.values: 归一化带宽 0.001 (default) | real scalar in the range (0 1)

params.name: Order of lowpass IIR elliptic filter
params.values: 低通 IIR 椭圆滤波器的阶数 6 (default) | integer greater than 3

params.name: Number of past input samples for FIR algorithm
params.values: FIR 算法使用的过去输入采样数 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
